story.title: Healthy Habits!
paragraphs_en: Its back to school time, and i really waited to go back and tell my friends this memory! We were telling each other what we did on our vacation! i had also brought some minature mangos from my vacation! Meena: haha! you ate that mango like an animal! saisha: Hey! it was extra sweet! everybody laughed*

Meena: hey Vidhatri, what did you do during summer vacations? Me: oh! Me and my family went to visit the village to show me how the village life is like! Saisha: Wow! what was it like? Meena: Yeah! it sounds intresting! tell us tell us! Vidhatri: haha ok ok!

When we headed there, it was so different from the city! Some of our family members live there. They told me about so many things village have and cities don't like the bright clear sky ! and i was introduced to "daatoon" it is neem twigs, they use it to brush their teeth! it is natural and an antiseptic which cures all teeth ailments naturally ! it also is toothache reliever! So you see they dont need a dentist :-). They have a very good habit of using it often and keeping their teeth clean and germfree. Washing hands often and gargling mouth every time eat keeps their teeth shiny and healthy

Meena: that sounds so interesting! Vidhatri: And when it hit night time, the electricity went out! so we slept on the roof and such a beautiful sky full of stars and used our imagination to make things out of the stars! My sister said at those star form a butter chicken! and i m getting already hungry thinking about it! everybody laughed*. I was unknowingly learning so many good habits , using natural products , live in fresh open air , close to environment

They have such good healthy habits as they walk for miles! Doing so many physical activities in their day to day life . they are not potato couch like most of us . They wake up early sleep early and have all their food on time . All home cooked food , no junk good . I also taught yoga to some of the villagers which i learned from school and had fun! Then all the villagers said goodbye and we came back home with such sweet memories and so many good habbits which will definitely keep me healthy. Saisha: wow! next vacation i will also ask my parents if we can also go to the village!
Healthy habits is a book about village life and healthy habits they have. And also telling what Indian village life is like. I have taken inspiration from my mothers stories when she was little!

sentences.text_en: All home cooked food , no junk good .
sentences.text_vi: Toàn bộ là đồ ăn nhà nấu, không có đồ ăn vặt.

sentences.text_en: I also taught yoga to some of the villagers which i learned from school and had fun!
sentences.text_vi: Tớ cũng đã dạy yoga cho một số người dân làng, điều mà tớ học được ở trường và rất vui!
